main_text.l: Aut Ephesum, bimarisve CorinthiMoenia, vel Baccho Thebas, vel Apolline DelphosInsignes, aut Thessala Tempe.Est locus Aetherei prarupto in vertice montis,Delicijs plenus, quo non felicior alterCreditur esse vsquam, cui cedunt Thessala Tempe,Elysiique lares, & fortunata vireta.
An viros tellus dare militaresAptior Phthiæ?
Huic armat Larissa viros, huic celsa prosymneAptior armentis Midea, petorosaque Phyllos.
